verdict.rationale: Several items support clean removal indirectly. Skills are self-contained directories (a SKILL.md plus optional scripts, references and assets), and plugins install and load as one unit, so removing a skill largely means deleting one folder or plugin. Docs also mention that skills can be managed in Claude Code and through the Skills API, and that bundled skills can be turned off with `disableBundledSkills`. However, no evidence documents an actual list-installed command or an uninstall/remove workflow. Missing for 10: explicit list-installed command or API, documented plugin uninstall or skill removal command, guarantees against orphaned files or leftover instructions, and hands-on corroboration of clean removal.
